registry_disposition.reason: S12 of MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0 (section 11.5) adds a new canonical contract to core/contracts/ (executor-model-profile.schema.json) and amends an existing one (materiality-decision.schema.json, component vocabulary gains effective_instruction_digest). Both are CONTRACT_RECORD class changes under the registry-disposition.v1 consumer binding of this repository (AGENTS.md, Registry Disposition Consumer Binding: CONTRACT_RECORD, PROVENANCE, SUPERSESSION). The S7 qualification-integration merge (PR #47, 27b17b6) landed between the first publication of this slice and the S7-compliance repair: it made effective_instruction_digest a REQUIRED component of core/contracts/qualification-fingerprint.schema.json, and the S12 slice - written before that merge - built qualification fingerprints without it, so after the rebase the canonical contract rejected every S12 fingerprint. The repair makes the S12 lane comply with the merged contract (the fixture and the inline test fingerprints carry the required component with canonically recomputed fingerprint digests; R8 compares the pinned digest, the fingerprint's digest component and the currently effective digest and refuses a fingerprint that states none), while reading the S7 contract, builder and materiality rules without amending them; the materiality-decision component enum carries effective_instruction_digest exactly once after the rebase, so the identical S7 and S12 amendments are de-duplicated. The registry write is its own registered change and follows after the owner merges the source change (precedent: evidence/skill-feedback-contract-2026-10-20/ and evidence/instruction-bundles-2026-10-20/, which followed the same two-phase REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED -> UPDATED rebind pattern). This slice does not perform the registry write, so no registry commit exists yet and registry_commit_sha stays null; implementation_commit_sha is bound to the landing commit of the S7-compliance repair. No authority, permission, runtime activation or qualification state is granted or changed by this slice: a model-adaptive executor profile is a presentation layer with authority_grant none, and the qualification state is recorded, never conferred.
